BS CARVE-OUTS (keys not on the face of the BS, taken from notes so that components still sum to face totals): rou = operating-lease ROU assets (lease note / XBRL OperatingLeaseRightOfUseAsset; 2019 on face) deducted from other_assets; lt_lease_liab = noncurrent operating lease liabilities (lease note / XBRL OperatingLeaseLiabilityNoncurrent; other-LTL table 2021+) deducted from other_ncl; current operating lease liabilities (19.6/21.2/28.3/29.4/30.1/30.2/32.0 for 2019-2025) remain inside accrued_liab; dtl 2013-2019 = 'Deferred tax liabilities | Other long-term liabilities' from the selected-BS-items table, deducted from other_ncl (face line from 2020 as recast); dta 2013-2014 = current deferred tax assets inside prepaid (ASU 2015-17 adopted prospectively in 2015, no current DTA thereafter; noncurrent DTA inside other assets not disclosed - left in other_assets); contract_liab = current contract liabilities / customer deposits deducted from accrued_liab: 2013-2015 'Customer deposits and credits' (selected BS items table), 2018-2025 & 1H/26 XBRL ContractWithCustomerLiabilityCurrent / accrued-liabilities note; 2016-2017 omitted (only a broader 'customer related accruals, deposits and credits' 72.4/109.6 disclosed). Noncurrent contract liabilities (15.3/17.9/14.0/25.3/20.2/25.5/30.5/33.6 for 2018-2025; 32.7 at 1H/26) remain in other_ncl.

pension_liab = noncurrent pension + postretirement liabilities inside 'Other long-term liabilities'. 2021-2025: 'Pension and postretirement related liabilities' line of the other-LTL note (67.2/50.2/57.8/58.8/60.0). 2015-2020: pension note (domestic accrued LT + domestic 'other long-term liabilities' row + foreign accrued LT) + postretirement accrued LT: 2015 33.8+5.0+12.8+9.6=61.2; 2016 34.5+5.2+9.3+8.7=57.7; 2017 35.4+5.5+11.1+8.7=60.7; 2018 31.8+5.2+8.6+7.7=53.3; 2019 33.8+5.3+11.7+7.2=58.0; 2020 51.6+5.9+15.5+7.2=80.2. 2013/2014: selected-BS-items 'accrued pension obligation' (8.5/14.2) + pension-note 'other liabilities' row (3.1/5.2) + postretirement LT (10.3/11.6) = 21.9/31.0. Precision +/-0.2 (minor rounding differences between tables). Not disclosed in the Q2-26 10-Q: for 1H/26 pension_liab, rou and lt_lease_liab are NOT carved out (they remain in other_ncl / other_assets) - compare with care.

CF KEY MAPPING: chg_wc = sum of ALL lines under 'Changes in operating assets and liabilities' incl. 'Other operating, net'/'Other, net', and 'Deferred and income taxes payable, net' (from the FY2018 10-K deferred taxes are no longer a separate line, so deferred_tax is given for 2013-2015 only and is inside chg_wc for 2016+); pension_cf = separate 'Accrued pension obligation'/'Pension benefits' + 'Accrued postretirement benefits'/'Postretirement benefits' lines (net pension expense less contributions), given 2013-2016 (the FY2019+ 10-Ks fold them into other operating lines, so 2017+ pension effects are inside chg_wc); no separate pension_contrib line. other_noncash = noncontrolling interest, excess tax benefit from stock options (negative reversal in CFO, pre-2017), change in FV of derivatives, bridge financing & debt extinguishment (income)/expense, impairment of intangibles (2024: 52.5), gain on debt extinguishment (2025: -15.0). gain_disp = gain on sale of facility (2016: -17.9). Zero values are written only where the source CF row shows '—' for that year.

CF da = 'Depreciation and amortization' line (total). depreciation / amortization keys are MEMO (not part of the CFO sum): depreciation from XBRL us-gaap:Depreciation tagged in the 10-K (2013-2025); amortization = acquired-intangible amortization (10-K note / IS line). 2021 D&A 371.8 includes $106.4m FLIR acquired inventory step-up amortization (FY2022 10-K segment note footnote) so depreciation+amortization (264.5) < da. 2019/2020 depreciation+amortization fall 0.9/0.8 short of da because amortization uses the recast IS line (36.5/38.8; originally 37.4/39.6). 1H/26 depreciation not disclosed (amortization 113.6 from IS).

CF financing mapping: st_debt_net = net credit-facility borrowings/(repayments) and 2013 'Net proceeds (payments) - long-term debt' (-5.0; net presentation); debt_issued = proceeds from senior notes / term loans / other debt (2021: 3,975.9 net of issuance costs as presented); debt_repaid = payments on other debt; FY2025 10-K presents NET lines 'Proceeds from (payments on) fixed rate senior notes' and '... other debt' (2023-2025 recast from the FY2024 presentation of 'Payments on other debt' 553.9/600.6 and credit facility) -> negative net lines put in debt_repaid (2025: -162.0 notes repurchased at discount + -1.8 other = -163.8; 1H/26: -450.0 1.60% notes + -0.6). buybacks = purchase of treasury stock (incl. excise tax 2025: 402.9 vs $400.0m repurchased). tax_benefit_sbc = excess tax benefits from stock options (financing; 2013-2014 only - the FY2017 10-K, the latest presenting 2015, merged the 2015 amounts (4.3 in CFO reversal and financing) into other lines after ASU 2016-09). other_fin = issuance/settlement of cash flow hedges, purchase of option contract (2016: -11.6, e2v FX hedge), cross-currency swap liquidations (2022 +43.1, 2023 -13.5, 2024 -18.7), payments for bridge financing & debt extinguishment (2021: -30.5), acquisition of redeemable NCI (2025: -27.2), other financing. dividends = 0 (no dividend line; Teledyne pays none - see supplemental.dividend_policy).

CF investing: other_investing = escrow lines (2016: -19.5/+19.5) and from FY2019 10-K 'Other, net'/'Other investing, net' (this line replaced 'Proceeds from the sale of businesses and disposal of fixed assets'; 2017-2018 values 1.4/1.3 identical, so proceeds_disp appears only where the latest CF still labels it so: 2013-2016). acquisitions = 'Purchase of businesses and other investments (net of cash acquired)' - includes minority investments (e.g. Ocean Aero) and NCI purchases of earlier years (2015 includes $22.0m Optech NCI buyout).
